publications.title: HB 149 Pass-Through Entity Tax FAQ
publications.summary: Georgia Department of Revenue questions and answers on the HB 149 (2021) election: for taxable years beginning on or after January 1, 2022, S corporations and partnerships may annually make an irrevocable election to pay income tax at the entity level. Covers who may elect (all partnerships from 2023), making the election on Form 600S or Form 700, estimated tax payments, how owners report entity-taxed income (PTEDED) and loss (PTEADD) on Form 500, composite returns, and tax attributes and credits.
